name: Balance EQ Situations and Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Starting points for Balance EQ for mixing down and mastering in many music styles and situations: club, festival, big room, home hi-fi, headphones, studio reference, radio and car, plus 32 music styles for streaming. The Situations folder uses a common style for each situation (house for club, EDM for festival and big room, pop for home, headphones, radio, car and streaming, transparent for studio). The values follow the same recipes as the Master Director.
